resources.string: Enter an http or https URL, such as https://example.com/tokkl. Leave out any user name or password.
An email can\'t contain a colon.
Wrong API token. Check it and try again.
Wrong email or password. Check them and try again.
Too many failed attempts. Wait for the countdown before you try again.
Can\'t reach the server. Check the URL and your connection.
The server answered with HTTP %d. Check the URL.
That URL doesn\'t answer like a Tokkl server. Check it.
The server didn\'t send an API token. Sign in with your API token instead.
The server redirected to %1$s. The app talks only to the URL you entered, so it sent nothing there.
Couldn\'t store the API token on this phone. Try again.
Couldn\'t save your answer on this phone, so the app sent nothing. Try again.

%1$s uses plain http. Your API token or password would travel unencrypted, so anyone on the network between this phone and the server could read it. Continue only if the network encrypts the traffic, as Tailscale does.
I understand that my API token or password travels unencrypted

No certificate authority on this phone vouches for %1$s, so the app sent nothing. Trust the certificate only if its fingerprint matches the one on your server. The app will then accept this certificate, and no other, from that server.

%1$s presents a different certificate from the one you trusted, so the app sent nothing. If you didn\'t replace it, someone may be intercepting the connection. Trust the new certificate only if its fingerprint matches the one on your server.
